svg.title: Samvriti.Space — The Whorl
svg.desc: One unbroken line draws a thumb held to the page. It comes up the left edge of the pad from the bottom of the frame, over the tip, and down the right edge — and there, low on the side where a print has its delta, the edge stops being an edge and becomes a ridge: it turns back on itself and winds inward three and a half times to a still centre. The contour and the print are the same stroke; the outermost ridge of any real impression is the edge of the finger. In India a thumb impression is what you leave when a signature will not do — the plainest available proof that a particular person was here. Open at the bottom, where the hand would be. One path, one M, no Z.
